Fact.Name: Schedules K-3 received
Fact.Description: Source documents received on Schedule K-3 (Form 1065), Partner's Share of Income, Deductions, Credits, etc.—International, and Schedule K-3 (Form 1120-S), Shareholder's Share of Income, Deductions, Credits, etc.—International: one item per schedule received (https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/f1065sk3.pdf, page 1; https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/f1120sk3.pdf, page 1). ONE collection holds both, because the two schedules print the same Parts I-III and the same distribution, CFC, PFIC and section 960 grids (the Form 1120-S schedule numbers them Parts IV-VII where the Form 1065 schedule numbers them V-VIII), so every leaf is named for what the box holds rather than for its Part number. Parts a schedule does not print are simply never answered on it. Nested collections hold the rows that repeat inside one schedule. Absent on a return that received none: complete-safe, and every return-level fact that reads it opens with a Not(IsComplete) case. The reading contract is dictionary/pdf/2025/IRS1065SK3/en/configuration.yml and dictionary/pdf/2025/IRS1120SK3/en/configuration.yml.

Fact.Name: Schedule K-3 owner
Fact.Description: The filer on this return the Schedule K-3 is addressed to as partner (box C and D of the Form 1065 schedule) or shareholder (the Form 1120-S schedule). An unanswered owner is Incomplete; no primary-filer default is assumed. Read only by ../partnerOrShareholderTin.

Fact.Name: Schedule K-3 belongs to the primary filer
Fact.Description: Whether this Schedule K-3 belongs to the primary filer. Read off the owner itself (../filer/isPrimaryFiler), completeness-first: an unanswered ../filer resolves complete-safe FALSE rather than Incomplete, and on a single-filer return the one filer is the primary, so the secondary arm is Complete false. Kept in the shape every input-form collection with a filer link carries; no fact reads it yet.

Fact.Name: Schedule K-3 belongs to the secondary filer
Fact.Description: Whether this Schedule K-3 belongs to the secondary filer. Read off the owner itself (../filer/isSecondaryFiler), completeness-first: an unanswered ../filer resolves complete-safe FALSE rather than Incomplete, and on a single-filer return the one filer is the primary, so the secondary arm is Complete false. Kept in the shape every input-form collection with a filer link carries; no fact reads it yet.

Fact.Name: Schedule K-3 box C: partner's or shareholder's identifying number
Fact.Description: Box C of the Form 1065 schedule (Partner's SSN or TIN) and box C of the Form 1120-S schedule (Shareholder's identifying number), with every page-header repeat of it: DERIVED from this document's own owner (../filer/tin): the primary filer's TIN on the primary filer's schedule and the secondary filer's on the spouse's, never the return's primary filer by default. Incomplete while ../filer is unanswered. No computation on this return reads it.

Fact.Name: Schedule K-3 direct foreign taxes, one row, column (g), floored and complete-safe
Fact.Description: One line-1 row's column (g) Total, as the return uses it: $0 when unanswered, floored at zero when answered. The floor is in this body because the engine does not enforce a Min limit on resolution, and a negative direct foreign tax would understate the amount the reconciliation refusal compares.

Fact.Name: Schedule K-3 direct foreign taxes, this schedule, column (g)

Complete $0 when the schedule prints no line-1 row: the first case is Not(IsComplete) over the nested row collection, because a bare CollectionSum over an absent collection is not zero.

Fact.Name: Schedule K-3 reduction of taxes, this schedule, column (g)

The Form 1116 instructions route this line to Form 1116 line 12.

Fact.Name: Schedule K-3 foreign tax redetermination row carries an amount

Fact.Name: Schedule K-3 reports a foreign tax redetermination
Fact.Description: True when this K-3 prints a nonzero line-3 redetermination amount or has an explicitly identified foreign-tax section 3 or 4, line-3 translation entry with a nonzero supplied USD amount. Missing collections, incomplete translation identities, metadata-only entries and zero translation amounts do not trigger the attachment condition. Existing printed-row behavior is preserved. Also true when the attached Schedule C (Form 1116) information carries a nonzero tax change, liability difference or contested-tax amount (../scheduleCRedeterminationAmountReported).

Fact.Name: Schedule K-3 reports non-passive foreign-source gross income

Fact.Name: Direct foreign taxes reported on every Schedule K-3 received

COMPLETE $0 ON A RETURN THAT RECEIVED NO SCHEDULE K-3: the first case is Not(IsComplete) over /formK3s. IT IS NOT AN ADDEND OF FORM 1116 LINE 8 AND MUST NOT BECOME ONE BY ACCIDENT: the Form 1116 instructions route these amounts into Part II of each applicable Form 1116, the country rows form1116:/form1116ForeignCountries already holds, so adding this total to line 8 would count the same dollars twice. It is the amount foreignTaxCredit:/knockoutScheduleK3ForeignTaxesReachNoLine compares: taxes received that reach neither Form 1116 Part II nor the Schedule 3 line 1 intake refuse the return. The total is across all categories, and a Form 1116 is per category, so nothing here carries a row into a Form 1116 country row; that carry is a named successor.

Fact.Name: Schedule K-3 direct foreign taxes in a category the return's Form 1116 does not report
Fact.Description: The Schedule K-3 line-1 direct foreign taxes in every category column whose Form 1116 category box the filer has ANSWERED unchecked: column (b) against box a (section 951A category income), column (c) against box b (foreign branch category income), column (d) against box c (passive category income), column (e) against box d (general category income), and column (f) Other against boxes e (section 901(j) income) and f (income re-sourced by treaty) together, counted only when both of those are answered unchecked. The Schedule K-3 instructions put each category's taxes on the Form 1116 for that category, and this dictionary holds one Form 1116, so these are the taxes the return cannot carry. A box left unanswered contributes nothing here: /knockoutForm1116CategoryBoxesNotExactlyOne and the completeness of Form 1116 govern that state. Complete on every return.

Read before the column (u) subtractions, because the Schedule K-3 prints the taxes before any section 901(k), 901(l) or contested-tax bar, and those bars are entered on Form 1116, not removed from the Schedule K-3. Incomplete while the country table is unanswered or any row leaves a column (q) through (t) unanswered; its only reader, /knockoutScheduleK3ForeignAmountsNotCarried, reads it behind IsComplete.

Fact.Name: Knockout: a Schedule K-3 attaches international information this return cannot report or compute
Fact.Description: SCREEN: "Your Schedule K-3 includes information you need to report on a form this software can't prepare." HELP: a partnership attaches some Schedule K-3 statements because a partner has to use them on a return of its own or on an information return; this return is refused rather than filed without them. FOUR ARMS, EACH COMPLETE-SAFE, so the guard is Complete false on every return that received no Schedule K-3. (J) A SECTION 6038B TRANSFER: a Schedule K-3 attaches a transfer of property to a foreign partnership, or a disposition of contributed property, carrying a nonzero amount (/scheduleK3ForeignPartnershipTransferReported); the partnership attaches it when it did not report the transfer itself, so each partner reports its share of the transfer on Form 8865, which this software does not prepare. (K) SECTION 721(c) GAIN DEFERRAL: a Schedule K-3 attaches a section 721(c) property row or event carrying a nonzero amount (/scheduleK3Section721cGainDeferralReported); the gain deferral method's reporting and acceleration events are not computed. (L) SECTION 987: a Schedule K-3 attaches a section 987 information statement answering a gain or loss the partner recognizes (/scheduleK3Section987GainOrLossReported); that partner is a category 5 filer of Form 8858 and recognizes the section 987 gain or loss, neither of which this software prepares. (M) NII PTEP WITHOUT A HOLDING: Form 8960 is required (form8960:/form8960RequiredForReturn), a Schedule K-3 attaches a Worksheet 4 NII PTEP distribution with a nonzero U.S. dollar amount (/scheduleK3NiiPtepDistributionReported), and no CFC or QEF amount reaches Form 8960 line 6 on either route (form8960:/niitCfcQefLine6Adjustment, form8960:/niitLine6CfcQefElectionInPlaceInclusion and form8960:/niitLine6CfcQefNoElectionAdjustment all $0 or unanswered), so the distribution reaches no net investment income line. NOT REFUSED: attachment metadata, zero amounts and statements that no arm reads. Dual-wired: BlockSubmissionOnTrue plus membership in flow /flowIsKnockedOut. interpretation:provisional.

Fact.Name: Knockout: a Schedule K-3 reports a foreign-tax amount this return cannot carry
Fact.Description: SCREEN: "Your Schedule K-3 reports foreign-tax information this software can't yet use for your foreign tax credit." HELP: a partnership or S corporation reports your share of foreign taxes, their reductions and their redeterminations, and the category of your foreign income, on Schedule K-3; the credit you claim has to follow those amounts. This return is refused rather than filed with a credit that ignores them. NINE ARMS, EACH COMPLETE-SAFE, so the guard is Complete false on every return that received no Schedule K-3. (A) A REDUCTION NOT CARRIED: a Schedule K-3 prints a line-2 reduction of taxes (/scheduleK3ForeignTaxReductionsTotal greater than $0) or an explicitly identified section 3 or 4 line-2 translation entry reports a nonzero USD amount, the return claims the credit (Form 1116 line 8 Complete and greater than $0, or the Schedule 3 line 1 intake answered and greater than $0), and Form 1116 line 12 carries nothing; the Form 1116 instructions route that line to line 12, so the credit would be overstated. (B) A REDETERMINATION: a Schedule K-3 prints an amount on a line-3 row or reports a nonzero USD amount on an explicitly identified section 3 or 4, line-3 translation entry; the Form 1116 instructions route it to Schedule C (Form 1116), which this dictionary does not build. (C) NON-PASSIVE FOREIGN INCOME ON THE NO-FORM-1116 ROUTE: a Schedule K-3 prints a positive Part II line 24 amount in column (b), (d) or (e) while the return takes the no-Form-1116 exception (foreignTaxCredit:/qualifiesForNoForm1116Exception); the exception needs all foreign-source gross income to be interest and dividends reported on a qualified statement, so the filer's attestation and the schedule disagree. (D) LINE-1 TAXES IN A SECOND CATEGORY: the return claims the credit on Form 1116 (/scheduleK3CreditClaimedOnForm1116) and a Schedule K-3 prints line-1 direct foreign taxes in a category column whose Form 1116 box is answered unchecked (/scheduleK3DirectForeignTaxesOutsideForm1116Category greater than $0); the instructions put each category's taxes on a separate Form 1116, and this dictionary holds one, so those taxes cannot be carried. (E) LINE-1 TAXES NOT CARRIED IN FULL ON FORM 1116: on the same route, the Form 1116 Part II columns (q) through (t) of every country row (/scheduleK3Form1116PartIIGrossTaxesCompared, read behind IsComplete) add to less than the Schedule K-3 line-1 total less the taxes of arm D; a filer who takes the credit for any eligible foreign tax cannot deduct any part of that year's foreign taxes, so every Schedule K-3 tax of the checked category belongs in Part II. A row that prints only its column (g) total is attributed to the checked category here. (F) LINE-1 TAXES OUTSIDE THE PASSIVE CATEGORY ON THE NO-FORM-1116 ROUTE: the return takes the no-Form-1116 credit (/scheduleK3CreditClaimedWithoutForm1116) and a Schedule K-3 prints line-1 taxes in column (b), (c), (e) or (f); the exception reaches only foreign tax on interest and dividends. (G) LINE-1 TAXES NOT CARRIED IN FULL ON THE NO-FORM-1116 ROUTE: on that route, the Schedule 3 line 1 foreign tax intake is less than the Schedule K-3 line-1 total. (H) A FOREIGN TAX CREDIT ADJUSTMENT STATEMENT ON A CREDIT RETURN: the return claims the credit on either route and a Schedule K-3 attaches a splitter-arrangement (section 909), section 267A or GloBE statement carrying a nonzero amount (/scheduleK3ForeignTaxCreditAdjustmentStatementReported); the suspension and disallowance those statements report change the creditable tax and its allocation base, which this return does not compute. (I) A FOREIGN OIL AND GAS TAX ON A CREDIT RETURN: the return claims the credit on either route and a Schedule K-3 attaches a foreign oil and gas row or statement carrying a nonzero tax or reduction (/scheduleK3ForeignOilGasTaxReported); section 907(a) reduces the foreign oil and gas taxes taken into account under section 901, and this return does not compute that reduction. Arm (B) also reads the Schedule C (Form 1116) information a Schedule K-3 attaches. NOT REFUSED: a return that carries the Schedule K-3 line-1 taxes in full on a matching Form 1116 or on the Schedule 3 line 1 intake, a filer who answered the election for the deduction (the credit is elective), and the Part II and Part III figures a Form 1116 filer enters on Form 1116 directly. A return whose line-1 taxes reach no credit line at all is foreignTaxCredit:/knockoutScheduleK3ForeignTaxesReachNoLine's. Dual-wired: BlockSubmissionOnTrue plus membership in flow /flowIsKnockedOut. interpretation:provisional.

Fact.Name: Received corporation stock value
Fact.Description: Received corporation stock value. Received on an attachment to a partnership or S corporation Schedule K-3. The containing document and nested collection retain the origin and parent relationship. Each supplied record and cell remains independent. Blank readings remain unanswered. Part III section 2 lines 7 and 8 identify foreign-corporation stock; voting and value percentages are distinct readings. Retain the independently supplied U.S.-dollar stock value; do not derive adjusted basis, earnings-and-profits adjustments or any grouping total. For S corporation line 8 the issuer requests a standalone corporation value. Existing USD intake consumers and supported Form 1116 or section 904(j) routes are unchanged. No treatment or eligibility is inferred from this attachment.

Fact.Name: Tax-translation entry reports a foreign tax redetermination
Fact.Description: True only when this received entry identifies Part III foreign-tax section 3 or 4, line 3, and a nonzero supplied U.S.-dollar amount. The positive or negative change is an operative redetermination routed to Schedule C (Form 1116). A zero or missing USD amount, missing section or line, line 1 or 2, or metadata-only entry does not trigger this signal. No amount is converted, summed or inferred. The existing per-document redetermination flag consumes this signal.

Fact.Name: Tax-translation entry reports a foreign tax reduction
Fact.Description: True only for an explicitly identified Part III foreign-tax section 3 or 4, line 2, with a complete nonzero supplied USD amount. Missing identities, missing or zero USD, line 1 or 3 and metadata-only entries are false. This is a signal only; the amount is never added to the printed reduction total.

Fact.Name: This K-3 has a supplied tax-translation reduction amount
Fact.Description: True when any supplied tax-translation entry for this K-3 reports a nonzero USD line-2 reduction under foreign-tax section 3 or 4. Absent or empty entry collections are false. This flag does not calculate a reduction or duplicate a printed total.

Fact.Name: A K-3 supplied tax-translation entry reports a reduction
Fact.Description: True when a received K-3 has an explicitly identified nonzero USD foreign-tax line-2 translation amount. The existing missing-line-12 refusal consumes this Boolean together with the credit-claimed condition. No amount is added to the printed reduction total, so matching printed and attachment readings are never counted twice.

Fact.Name: Partnership K-3 personal property sale rows
Fact.Description: Each received Table 1 property/country row attached to Part I box 1 of a 2025 Schedule K-3 (Form 1065). Preserve separate rows for each taxing country and the issuer's permitted grouping of stock sales by country. S-corp applicability: For Form 1120-S this is the same Table 1, columns (a) through (f), with separate property/country rows and received cross-country footnotes. Do not sum duplicate-property rows.

Fact.Name: Property sold
Fact.Description: The property description received in Table 1 column (a) of this 2025 Schedule K-3 attachment. S-corp applicability: For Form 1120-S this is the same Table 1, columns (a) through (f), with separate property/country rows and received cross-country footnotes. Do not sum duplicate-property rows.

Fact.Name: Capital gain holding period
Fact.Description: The long-term or short-term label received in Table 1 column (b) of this 2025 Schedule K-3 attachment. Leave unanswered when the issuer supplies no capital-gain holding period. S-corp applicability: For Form 1120-S this is the same Table 1, columns (a) through (f), with separate property/country rows and received cross-country footnotes. Do not sum duplicate-property rows.

Fact.Name: Gain on property sale
Fact.Description: The received gain in Table 1 column (c) of this 2025 Schedule K-3 attachment. Do not sum duplicate-property rows to compute return gain. S-corp applicability: For Form 1120-S this is the same Table 1, columns (a) through (f), with separate property/country rows and received cross-country footnotes. Do not sum duplicate-property rows.

Fact.Name: Tax paid in local currency
Fact.Description: The exact received local-currency tax amount in Table 1 column (d) of this 2025 Schedule K-3 attachment; no currency conversion or rounding is inferred. S-corp applicability: For Form 1120-S this is the same Table 1, columns (a) through (f), with separate property/country rows and received cross-country footnotes. Do not sum duplicate-property rows.

Fact.Name: Tax paid in U.S. dollars
Fact.Description: The independently received U.S.-dollar tax amount in Table 1 column (e) of this 2025 Schedule K-3 attachment. S-corp applicability: For Form 1120-S this is the same Table 1, columns (a) through (f), with separate property/country rows and received cross-country footnotes. Do not sum duplicate-property rows.

Fact.Name: Taxing country code
Fact.Description: The two-letter taxing-country code received in Table 1 column (f) of this 2025 Schedule K-3 attachment. The issuer instructions exclude OC and various. S-corp applicability: For Form 1120-S this is the same Table 1, columns (a) through (f), with separate property/country rows and received cross-country footnotes. Do not sum duplicate-property rows.

Fact.Name: Same-property reference
Fact.Description: The issuer-provided footnote or reference indicating that this 2025 Schedule K-3 Table 1 row and another country row concern the same property. Do not infer this association from similar descriptions. S-corp applicability: For Form 1120-S this is the same Table 1, columns (a) through (f), with separate property/country rows and received cross-country footnotes. Do not sum duplicate-property rows.

Fact.Name: Partnership K-3 loan rows
Fact.Description: Each separately received loan row in Table 2 (downstream) or Table 3 (upstream), attached to Part I box 10 of a 2025 Schedule K-3 (Form 1065). S-corp applicability: For Form 1120-S this also holds shareholder loan Tables 2 and 3: downstream loans from the shareholder or upstream loans to the shareholder, one row per loan. The existing path name does not imply that an S-corp loan has affiliated-partner rows.

Fact.Name: Received loan table number
Fact.Description: The table containing this 2025 Schedule K-3 loan row: 2 for downstream loans from a partner or its affiliated group to the partnership; 3 for upstream loans from the partnership to a partner or its affiliated group. S-corp applicability: For Form 1120-S this also holds shareholder loan Tables 2 and 3: downstream loans from the shareholder or upstream loans to the shareholder, one row per loan. The existing path name does not imply that an S-corp loan has affiliated-partner rows.

Fact.Name: Lender or borrower name
Fact.Description: The received lender name in Table 2, or borrower name in Table 3, of this 2025 Schedule K-3 attachment. The table number determines the reported role. S-corp applicability: For Form 1120-S this also holds shareholder loan Tables 2 and 3: downstream loans from the shareholder or upstream loans to the shareholder, one row per loan. The existing path name does not imply that an S-corp loan has affiliated-partner rows.

Fact.Name: Lender or borrower TIN
Fact.Description: The received TIN of the Table 2 lender or Table 3 borrower on this 2025 Schedule K-3 attachment. This counterparty is not presumed to be a filer on this return. S-corp applicability: For Form 1120-S this also holds shareholder loan Tables 2 and 3: downstream loans from the shareholder or upstream loans to the shareholder, one row per loan. The existing path name does not imply that an S-corp loan has affiliated-partner rows.

Fact.Name: Loan date
Fact.Description: The origination date received in this 2025 Schedule K-3 Table 2 or Table 3 row. It may precede the return year. S-corp applicability: For Form 1120-S this also holds shareholder loan Tables 2 and 3: downstream loans from the shareholder or upstream loans to the shareholder, one row per loan. The existing path name does not imply that an S-corp loan has affiliated-partner rows.

Fact.Name: Loan amount
Fact.Description: The nonnegative loan amount received in this 2025 Schedule K-3 Table 2 or Table 3 row, independently of the interest amount. S-corp applicability: For Form 1120-S this also holds shareholder loan Tables 2 and 3: downstream loans from the shareholder or upstream loans to the shareholder, one row per loan. The existing path name does not imply that an S-corp loan has affiliated-partner rows.

Fact.Name: Annual interest expense or income
Fact.Description: The nonnegative annual interest expense in Table 2 or interest income in Table 3 received on this 2025 Schedule K-3 attachment. Preserve the table number; this is not automatically a return deduction or income amount. S-corp applicability: For Form 1120-S this also holds shareholder loan Tables 2 and 3: downstream loans from the shareholder or upstream loans to the shareholder, one row per loan. The existing path name does not imply that an S-corp loan has affiliated-partner rows.

Fact.Name: Affiliated partners identified for K-3 loans

Fact.Name: Loan identifying this affiliated partner
Fact.Description: The specific received 2025 Schedule K-3 loan row whose lender or borrower has this partner in its affiliated group. Do not infer the link from a matching name.

Fact.Name: Affiliated partner name
Fact.Description: The affiliated partner name received for this 2025 Schedule K-3 loan attachment. Multiple partners can be reported for one loan.

Fact.Name: Affiliated partner TIN
Fact.Description: The affiliated partner TIN received for this 2025 Schedule K-3 loan attachment. It is an independently received counterparty identifier, not the return filer’s derived TIN.

Fact.Name: Splitter statement section number
Fact.Description: The received 2025 Schedule K-3 Part I box 3 statement section: 1 for potentially suspended taxes or 2 for potentially unsuspended taxes. This does not determine actual suspension. S-corp applicability: For Form 1120-S the same two statement sections record potentially suspended and potentially unsuspended taxes for each arrangement; optional category/source and current-year release information stay unanswered when absent.

Fact.Description: The origin year supplied in section 2 of the received 2025 Schedule K-3 splitter statement. An unanswered year is not inferred from the return year. Fact.Name: Basis-adjustment income or deduction class

Preserve the reported amount independently; this reading does not recalculate the cell. Part I reports additional tax accrued; Part II reports refunded or deemed-refunded tax. The received parent year group identifies the part. S-corp applicability: For Form 1120-S the issuer likewise requires a statement containing Schedule C (Form 1116), Parts I and II as applicable, for each foreign-tax redetermination. Preserve the separately received statement structure and amounts without recomputation.
